title: L3-F2: context packet must report actual readiness categories, not always engine-pending
description: Repair L3-F2 (evidence in eshyra-o9bd.16.3 notes). packet.ts ~457-467 selects every non-green clause and always says the record has engine-pending clauses; packetMessage.ts ~163-166 renders that verbatim. Effect: 21/240 magic items with adjudicated clauses but no engine-pending clauses (e.g. Bag of Devouring, Efficient Quiver, Horn of Valhalla) get a false engine-pending statement. Fix: derive the statement from the actual readiness categories present (engine-pending, adjudicated-by-design, design-blocked, etc.) and say engine-pending only when such clauses exist. Evidence: one generalized category-to-message test with a pure adjudicated item, an engine-pending item and a mixed input.
notes: Done by the Captain in commit 8cc290d6 on branch eshyra-o9bd.16.8. packet.ts readinessNote() names only the statuses present. Meanings are given only for the three clause-level categories; any other status is reported as unrecognized. Test: projectionLimitProvenance.test.ts, which checks Bag of Devouring (adjudicated only), Ammunition (engine-pending) and Animated Shield (mixed). verify:worktree passed.
